name: visualize-in-3d
description: Visualize anything in 3D - a place, a working system (airport, port, factory, hospital), an object, a creature, an event on real land, or how a thing works. Builds a live three.js app with a film, a lesson, a quick prototype, a documentary, an action short, a showcase, a cutaway plate or a web game, in clean, cinematic, technical or stylized looks, and checks its own frames. Use for "visualize X in 3D", "make a 3D film of X", "a live 3D dashboard of X", "show off this model", "dựng 3D cái này", "app nhìn như game", "làm phim 3D về", "cho 2 con đánh nhau", "pixel battle", "theme point cloud", "kiểu wildfire tool".
